NPDEV_AUTH_APIKEYS.why: An app with no key refuses to boot (fail-closed by design) -- anyone with the link reaches your data without one. Mint with `npdev host keys --new`.

NPDEV_SUPERUSER_BOOTSTRAPKEYHASH.why: No persistent disk on this target -- SUPER_USER_KEY.txt does not survive a restart. Without this you are locked out of ControlPanel after the first one. Mint the hash with `npdev admin hash-key`.
